suites.statement: The first line has n (1 <= n <= 2000). The second line has n bar heights between 0 and 1000, standing side by side, each one unit wide. Find the largest rectangle that fits entirely inside the bars (its width is a run of neighbouring bars and its height cannot be taller than the shortest bar in that run). Print its area. Time limit 2 seconds, memory 128 MB.

suites.statement: Two lines each have a non-empty string of lowercase letters (length at most 300). A subsequence is what remains after deleting some letters (maybe none) without reordering the rest. Print the length of the longest string that is a subsequence of both. Time limit 2 seconds, memory 128 MB.

suites.statement: The first line has n (1 <= n <= 2000). The second line has n integers between -1000000 and 1000000, arriving one at a time. After each number arrives, find the middle value of all numbers received so far, when they are sorted. If the count is even, use the lower of the two middle values. Print the n answers on one line separated by single spaces. Time limit 2 seconds, memory 128 MB.
